# AI Use-Case Design & Product Ownership — Exercise Sheets

Work in tables of 3–4. Each lab ends with something written down that you take back to work.

## Lab 1 — Frame three real problems

*Module 1: From pain point to AI task · about 36 minutes*

**With demo 1** (`python demos/01_frame_the_problem.py`): Frame three real problems from your team in the PAINS format. At least one should come out as 'not an AI problem' — if none does, you are not being honest.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 2 — Data checklist per use case

*Module 2: Data and feasibility · about 36 minutes*

**With demo 2** (`python demos/02_feasibility_score.py`): Score your own use case. Take the lowest line to the data owner this week — that conversation is the real lab.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 3 — Write an AI PRD

*Module 3: Requirements for AI · about 48 minutes*

**With demo 3** (`python demos/03_ai_prd_lint.py`): Write your PRD in data/prd.md. Run the linter until it passes. Then write the first ten rows of the evaluation set it prints.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 4 — Prototype and test

*Module 4: Prototyping without code · about 48 minutes*

**With demo 4** (`python demos/04_prototype_and_test.py`): Build the same bot in your no-code tool on the same documents. Run the same ten questions by hand. Do your scores match the script's? Where they differ, why?

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 5 — Delivery plan

*Module 5: Running the initiative · about 24 minutes*

**With demo 5** (`python demos/05_delivery_plan.py`): Draw your own stakeholder grid. Who can stop this project with one email? What will you show them at the next gate?

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.
